Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 9

“One who truly knows my divine birth and action in this way is not born again on leaving the body, but comes to me, Arjuna.”

Knowing here means grasping what the preceding verses described. Krishna offers understanding of his own nature as itself a liberating act, not merely as information held.
